Title: Submit User Details Form with valid name and phone number
Preconditions: Streamlit app is running and user has navigated to the Contact Us page
Steps: 1. Open the app | 2. Select "User Details Form" from the sidebar navigation | 3. Enter a valid name | 4. Enter a valid phone number | 5. Click "Submit"
Expected Result: A success message "Thank you, Jane Doe! Your details have been submitted." is displayed and the form fields are cleared

Title: Navigate from Home to Contact Us and then to User Details Form to submit details
Preconditions: App is freshly loaded on the Home page
Steps: 1. Launch the app (defaults to Home page) | 2. Select "Contact Us" from the sidebar and verify address/email/phone are shown | 3. Select "User Details Form" from the sidebar | 4. Enter name and phone number | 5. Click "Submit"
Expected Result: User can traverse Home -> Contact Us -> User Details Form via sidebar, and the form submission on the final page succeeds with a success message

Title: Submit phone number at the minimum allowed length boundary
Preconditions: User is on the User Details Form page
Steps: 1. Enter a valid name | 2. Enter a 7-character numeric phone number | 3. Click "Submit"
Expected Result: Form accepts the 7-digit phone number as valid and shows the success message (no "Please enter a valid phone number" error)

Title: Submit phone number containing allowed formatting characters
Preconditions: User is on the User Details Form page
Steps: 1. Enter a valid name | 2. Enter a phone number containing digits, spaces, parentheses, and a hyphen | 3. Click "Submit"
Expected Result: Form accepts the formatted phone number and shows the success message

Title: Submit form with empty name and empty phone number
Preconditions: User is on the User Details Form page
Steps: 1. Leave the Name field blank | 2. Leave the Phone Number field blank | 3. Click "Submit"
Expected Result: Both "Name is required." and "Phone number is required." error messages are displayed and no success message appears

Title: Submit form with a phone number containing invalid characters
Preconditions: User is on the User Details Form page
Steps: 1. Enter a valid name | 2. Enter a phone number containing letters, e.g. "abc-defg" | 3. Click "Submit"
Expected Result: The error message "Please enter a valid phone number." is displayed and no success message appears
